owner_decision.approved_text: Pre-register the V2 promotion rule: promote only when, over at least 10 completed gameweeks on the identical paired population, the MAE difference vs the FPL baseline has its 90% interval (gameweek-block resampling) entirely below 0 AND captain regret is no worse than FPL; promotion still requires an explicit owner approval (the rule makes a candidate eligible; it never auto-promotes).
owner_decision.source: reports/P1_FANTASY_VALIDATION.md, section 6 item 1 (suggested rule), approved by the owner 2026-11-23

population.name: IDENTICAL_PAIRED_PER_CANDIDATE
population.definition: FINAL (completed) gameweeks of output/fantasy_v2_oos.csv; rows where the candidate AND the FPL baseline both have a forecast and the actual is known; rows with a chronology violation (empty training window, or training on the row's own or a later gameweek) are excluded; duplicate (gw, element) rows are refused. Both arms are scored on exactly the same rows.

mae_diff_interval.statistic: MAE(candidate) - MAE(FPL) on the paired rows
mae_diff_interval.resampling: gameweek-block bootstrap: whole gameweeks drawn with replacement

captain_regret.statistic: sum over the paired gameweeks of (best actual score - actual score of the arm's top forecast), raw FPL points, ties broken by FPL element id

outcome.note: Eligibility never changes FANTASY_V2_RESIDUAL_MODE, the workflow, or any served number. Promotion needs an explicit owner approval and a separate reviewed change.
